tours.name: Delete a Payslip Batch
tours.description: Learn how to delete a payslip batch that was created by mistake and has no confirmed payslips.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to delete a payslip batch that was created by mistake and has no confirmed payslips.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Batches are managed in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Batches are managed in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu holds the payslips and the batches that group them.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu holds the payslips and the batches that group them.

steps.title: Batches
steps.description: A batch groups the payslips of one pay period. Only a batch that is still in draft can be deleted.

description_i18n.en_US: A batch groups the payslips of one pay period. Only a batch that is still in draft can be deleted.

steps.title: Find the payslip batch
steps.content: Type the name of the payslip batch and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the payslip batch and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

steps.title: Select it
steps.content: Tick the box in front of the payslip batch.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of the payslip batch.

steps.description: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to delete them together.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to delete them together.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

steps.title: Delete
steps.description: Deleting removes the record for good. Odoo only allows it when nothing else uses the record; if it is in use, archive it instead where that is offered.

description_i18n.en_US: Deleting removes the record for good. Odoo only allows it when nothing else uses the record; if it is in use, archive it instead where that is offered.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Delete in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Delete in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Deleting a batch also deletes the draft payslips inside it. Confirmed payslips must be cancelled first.

description_i18n.en_US: Deleting a batch also deletes the draft payslips inside it. Confirmed payslips must be cancelled first.
